summary: One real typo, on the flagged row itself. Rows 13-24 are Gakusen Toshi Asterisk season 2, a strictly weekly Saturday 22:30 run from 2016-04-02 to 2016-06-18 with no skips, so ep 23 = season-2 ep 11 = 2016-06-11 is forced. No day shift between stored and published dates for this series.

repairs.why: Ep 23 = Asterisk War S2 ep 11 'The Lonely Strega' (孤毒の魔女), aired 2016-06-11. en-WP 'The Asterisk War' episode table gives EpisodeNumber 23 / EpisodeNumber2 11 = June 11, 2016; AniList's airing schedule for Gakusen Toshi Asterisk 2 gives ep 11 = 2016-06-11. Stored 2015-12-11 belongs to the season-1 window (S1 ran 2015-10-03..12-19) - a year+month corruption, not a real date. Eps 22 (2016-06-04) and 24 (2016-06-18) are correct.

structure.notes: 24 rows = 12 + 12; S1 Sat 20:30 2015-10-03..12-19, S2 Sat 22:30 2016-04-02..06-18. Cumulative numbering matches en-WP's dual EpisodeNumber/EpisodeNumber2 columns exactly.
